# Clinaza — Embedded Healthcare & Dental Patient Financing Platform

> Point-of-care patient EMI financing (₹30,000 to ₹3,00,000) and free clinic management software for dental clinics across India.

Clinaza (https://clinaza.in) is India's leading embedded healthcare financing and dental CRM infrastructure. It enables doctors and clinic owners to offer instant, point-of-care EMI treatment financing through RBI-regulated banks and NBFC partners while providing a 100% free clinic CRM with automated WhatsApp recalls.

## Core Capabilities

- **Point-of-Care Patient Financing**: Instant pre-eligibility checks in under 2 minutes for treatments ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹3,00,000. Covers Dental Implants, Clear Aligners, Orthodontic Braces, Smile Makeovers, Root Canal Treatments, and Full Mouth Rehabilitations.
- **100% Free Dental CRM**: Comprehensive clinic management portal with patient timeline history, digital prescriptions, billing, and procedure tracking.
- **Automated WhatsApp Recalls & Campaigns**: 1-click patient reactivation for 6-month checkups, pending treatment plans, and post-procedure check-ins.
- **Multi-Lender Network**: Connected with RBI-regulated NBFCs and lending partners to maximize loan approval rates across Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 Indian cities.

## Geographic Coverage

Clinaza operates across 95+ cities in India including:
- **Tier 1**: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune
- **Tier 2 & 3**: Patna, Lucknow, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Surat, Vadodara, Kochi, Coimbatore, Varanasi, Ranchi, and more.

## Business Context & Target Audience

- **Healthcare Providers**: Dental practitioners, maxillofacial surgeons, orthodontists, and multi-specialty dental clinics looking to boost high-ticket procedure acceptance rates.
- **Patients**: Individuals seeking affordable 0% or low-cost monthly EMI payment options for major medical & dental care.
